viewSettingSkipTriggers: Skip triggers during skill tests that don't affect the outcome
viewSettingShowOtherPlayersHands: See the cards in other players' hands at all times.

settings.hideInertCardsTitle: Hide Cards With No Ongoing Effect
settings.hideInertCards: Once setup is over, tuck permanents whose text only applied at deck creation or setup — In the Thick of It, Adaptable, Observed — into a stack beside the play area.
settings.keybindings: Use Tabletop Simulator style keybinds. Note that some of them will only work in debug mode.
settings.inlineModals: Show dialogs at the top of the game instead of over the board. The dialog area can scroll, which is more comfortable on phones.
settings.sounds: Play sound effects in this browser.
settings.extraAnimations: Decorative effects like burning locations and the Cosmic Emissary beams. Never affects anything you need to see to play.
settings.extraAnimationsReducedMotion: Currently off anyway, because this device asks for reduced motion.
settings.cosmicEmissary: Shows animated Cosmic Emissary connection effects for Fate of the Vale.
settings.asIfRuling: Swap between Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 handling for "as if" effects during nested window checks. This affects everyone in the game.
settings.drawSpotlight: Show the cards you draw from your own deck, enlarged, the way an encounter card is shown.

chaosBagStats.caveat: Assumes one draw, expanding the extra draw that bless, curse and frost trigger. Card effects that reveal another token, the two-frost auto-fail, and draw-several-pick-one effects are not modeled.

fileBugPart1: This will store the current game state, and fill in a GitHub issue. You will need a GitHub account in order to proceed.
fileBugPart2: It should only take a moment to create the bug and you can resume playing once done.
fileBugPart3: The uploaded debug file will only include the last 30 steps so please ensure your issue is within that scope or provide additional information for recreating the issue.
bugTitleholder: A brief title for the bug
bugSubmittingTitle: Submitting bug, this may take several minutes, please wait...
bugSubmittingContent: When this process is done, it will open GitHub in a new window and you will be able to resume your game.
